comparison.objective: Candidate rejects open cartons from a belt; PR-1941 fills and removes a blood tube from an already placed needle without disturbing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires synchronized grasping, flap avoidance and level transport. PR-1941 requires bimanual holder stabilization, stopper insertion/removal and force-limited tube exchange.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades correct carton routing, no spill, tray dwell and no contact with normal cartons. PR-1941 grades fill, tube removal and tray placement while tightly limiting needle translation and pivot.
comparison.reason: Needle stabilization during press-fit tube exchange is a different tested ability. The PR body is empty, but all available task-spec versions provide sufficient objective and rubric detail.
